source_assessment.requirement: Coherent null meaning, strict finite UTC and legacy precision
source_assessment.evidence: schemas.py:27-57,130-143,283-317; drafts.ts:39-47,80-98; Authorization-only OpenAPI and two-field generated TS delta
source_assessment.assessment: Both fields remain required, with no default. The API accepts only both null or two strictly typed patterned UTC strings, validates real dates and strict ordering, and forbids extra fields. The frontend performs exact timestamp roundtrip validation and the same pair/order rule rather than allowing Date rollover. It returns original values rather than normalizing them. Shared Authorization is used by full and legacy DTOs; finite timestamps remain strings, and null is not turned into a far-future date or an execution grant. No runtime/lease/Stop behavior was changed.

source_assessment.requirement: Producer to API, durable representation and exact readback/history oracle
source_assessment.evidence: Wizard.tsx:19-47,95-117,134-167,239-248; client.ts:274-300; routes.py:59-169; service.py:30-51,58-80,104-132,134-243; both new test_engagements.py nodes
source_assessment.assessment: New forms produce real null/null. Explicitly enabling the period creates empty choices and Save is blocked until a valid ordered pair exists; disabling explicitly clears both. Hydration uses the received payload without date rewriting. Existing JSON serialization, POST/PUT, exact GET confirmation, CAS/revision/digest/command checks and append-only JSONB persistence paths remain unchanged. The service reads committed data, verifies each revision digest and reads the exact committed edit receipt rather than a potentially newer head. The new PG positive test checks null create, finite CAS edit, null CAS edit, fresh-app readback, exact ordered historical envelopes and direct stored payload/digest values. The negative test requires create/update422 plus an unchanged head and both table counts. These are meaningful persistence oracles, but are collected source only until parent execution.

source_assessment.requirement: True finite-history preservation, not a replacement digest computed from rewritten values
source_assessment.assessment: Source tests compare parsed full/legacy payloads with the original authored objects and compare revision_digest with a raw original envelope, independently of the changed model serializer. canonical_json itself is unchanged; this is not a separate implementation of its algorithm. The PG history oracle compares older API envelopes captured before subsequent edits and direct JSONB rows, rather than deriving all expected revisions from the newest head. Existing revision/digest checking and persistence code were not changed. No backfill or old-reader forward-compatibility is claimed.

source_assessment.requirement: Readable date-only presentation with deliberate UTC time changes
source_assessment.evidence: DatePicker.tsx:9-22,36-45,80-109; WizardSections.tsx ReviewStep; Wizard.test.tsx new controls
source_assessment.assessment: Trigger and saved summary show UTC day/month/year without technical ISO/time text. Exact stored seconds remain accessible and editable inside the same popup. New choices use the explicit start/end-of-day defaults, while existing valid times are retained when choosing/navigating dates; navigation and theme do not write a new value. Only day selection, explicit time edit or period disable changes it. The component controls cover exact finite12:34:56 retention through non-date save, an explicit13:45:06 edit, and a later real null/null save.

source_assessment.requirement: Keyboard, nonmodal popup, focus, month bounds and plausible narrow layout
source_assessment.assessment: The labelled native button opens a native nonmodal dialog, without inert state, a focus trap or a body lock. Day buttons use a single roving Tab stop; arrows, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown with shifted-year movement alter the cursor only. Month/day movement is clamped to years1-9999 and month-end length. Opening focuses the cursor day; selection/Escape/Done restore the trigger; outside pointer/focus departure closes without stealing focus from another control. Error associations are retained through Field. The popup reuses light/dark tokens, bounded scrolling and narrow fixed centering; its specific button rules override Wizard defaults. Geometry is plausible from source, not rendered-browser proof.
